# `fingerprint_features`

a person's spectral and connectome features over a span (MEG fingerprinting, steps 18 and 19), assembled from the bands' stored spectra and envelope correlations.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run fingerprint_features --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run fingerprint_features --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run bandpass   --recording rest      --lower L --upper U --design brainstorm_2018 --all --name rest_b         (step 9; a FIR that removes the mean reads the channel means: `run measure --set channel_span_mean --all` first)
nxr-neuro run bandpass   --recording emptyroom --lower L --upper U --design brainstorm_2018 --all --name emptyroom_b
nxr-neuro run noisecov   --recording rest_b      --all --block-seconds <10000 samples> --divisor samples_minus_one --name rest_b_data_cov       (step 11)
nxr-neuro run noisecov   --recording emptyroom_b --all --block-seconds <10000 samples> --divisor samples_minus_one --name emptyroom_b_noise_cov (step 12)
nxr-neuro run lcmv       --data-cov rest_b_data_cov --noise-cov emptyroom_b_noise_cov --name lcmv_b                                         (step 14)
nxr-neuro run noisecov         --recording rest_b --from S --to E --name rest_b_h_cov
nxr-neuro run region_pca       --recording rest_b --from S --to E --kernel lcmv_b --covariance rest_b_h_cov --partition desikan_killiany --name fp_h_b   (step 15)
nxr-neuro run fingerprint_band --recording rest_b --from S --to E --map fp_h_b --lower L --upper U                                                  (steps 17, 19)
nxr-neuro run fingerprint_features --recording rest --stem fp_h                                                                                         (steps 18, 19)
nxr-neuro run fingerprint_features --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --stem fp_A
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, where {"name": "$recording"} (the run the features are of) | yes |
| `spectrum_{band}` | for {"band": "$band_names"}, statistic any, where {"name": "${stem}_{band}_spectrum"} (each band's region spectrum (`nxr-neuro run fingerprint_band`)) | yes |
| `aec_{band}` | for {"band": "$band_names"}, statistic any, where {"name": "${stem}_{band}_aec"} (each band's amplitude envelope correlation (`nxr-neuro run fingerprint_band`)) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `required` | - |  | the run the features are of, by name |
| `stem` | `--stem` | `required` | - |  | the stem of the bands' statistics: <stem>_<band>_spectrum and <stem>_<band>_aec (fingerprint_band's names, its map named <stem>_<band>) |
| `band_names` | `--band-names` | `["delta", "theta", "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "high_gamma"]` | - |  | the bands, in order: one name each (the members of the band set) |
| `bands` | `--bands` | `["0-3.5 Hz", "4-7.5 Hz", "8-12.5 Hz", "13-29.5 Hz", "30-49.5 Hz", "50-150 Hz"]` | Hz |  | each band's cut of its spectrum, lo to hi INCLUSIVE (the reference's: 8 + 8 + 10 + 34 + 40 + 201 bins at 0.5 Hz) |
| `name` | `--name` | `{stem}` | - |  | the stem of the stored features: <name>_spectral and <name>_connectome |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`select.bands`](../nodes.md) |  | rule=frequency, bands=$bands, names=$band_names | bands |
| before | [`stats.spectralFeature`](../nodes.md) | spectra={'for': {'band': '$band_names'}, 'each': 'spectrum_{band}'}, bands=bands |  | spectral |
| before | [`stats.connectomeFeature`](../nodes.md) | matrices={'for': {'band': '$band_names'}, 'each': 'aec_{band}'}, bands=bands |  | connectome |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `spectral` | kind statistic, name $name_spectral, of recording, axes [{"name": "region"}, {"name": "frequency"}] |
| `connectome` | kind statistic, name $name_connectome, of recording, axes [{"name": "region"}, {"name": "region"}, {"name": "band"}] |

## Notes from the definition

```text
MEG BRAIN FINGERPRINTING, A PERSON'S TWO FEATURES OVER A SPAN (spec docs/specs/2026-11-16-meg-fingerprinting.md, section 11.3, steps 18 and 19, section 12.1; its amendment of 2026-11-19: the published
method is the default). The method: da Silva Castanheira J, Orozco Perez HD, Misic B, Baillet S (2021) Brief segments of neurophysiological activity enable individual differentiation. Nat Commun
12:5713, doi:10.1038/s41467-021-25895-8; its authors' release megFingerprinting v1.0.0 (06fdba8). Every stored result carries this citation (producer_json.references).

THE GRAPH (no data is streamed: the bands' statistics `fingerprint_band` stored, read by name):
  before:  select.bands                the band SET: each band's cut, its edges INCLUSIVE (a member holds its Welch bins lo to hi), by default the reference's: delta 0-3.5 Hz, theta 4-7.5, alpha 8-12.5,
                                       beta 13-29.5, gamma 30-49.5, high gamma 50-150  ->  bands
           stats.spectralFeature       step 18: each band's region spectrum cut to its band, the bands side by side (8 + 8 + 10 + 34 + 40 + 201 = 301 bins at 0.5 Hz)  ->  spectral [regions x bins]
           stats.connectomeFeature     step 19: the bands' amplitude envelope correlations on a band axis  ->  connectome [regions x regions x bands]
Stored: `<name>_spectral` and `<name>_connectome`, OF the recording: what `run fingerprint` reads as a member's target or database (`--vector flatten` for the spectral feature,
`--vector upper-triangle` for the connectome: per band the upper triangle with its diagonal).

THE RUN ORDER, ONE SUBJECT (composition cannot write it as one definition: each band and each half is its own recording, kernel and span). The halves are step 16's: the training (database) half
A = [5 s, floor(T/2)] and the validation (target) half B = [ceil(T/2), T - 5 s], T the run's last time (the release takes T from the last band's file: every band is the same run, cut by the same
filter, so it is the run's own T here). The bands of the sensor band-pass are the reference's: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-13, beta 13-30, gamma 30-50, high gamma 50-150 Hz.
  for each band b (lower, upper):
    nxr-neuro run bandpass   --recording rest      --lower L --upper U --design brainstorm_2018 --all --name rest_b         (step 9; a FIR that removes the mean reads the channel means: `run measure --set channel_span_mean --all` first)
    nxr-neuro run bandpass   --recording emptyroom --lower L --upper U --design brainstorm_2018 --all --name emptyroom_b
    nxr-neuro run noisecov   --recording rest_b      --all --block-seconds <10000 samples> --divisor samples_minus_one --name rest_b_data_cov       (step 11)
    nxr-neuro run noisecov   --recording emptyroom_b --all --block-seconds <10000 samples> --divisor samples_minus_one --name emptyroom_b_noise_cov (step 12)
    nxr-neuro run lcmv       --data-cov rest_b_data_cov --noise-cov emptyroom_b_noise_cov --name lcmv_b                                         (step 14)
    for each half h in A, B (its span --from/--to):
      nxr-neuro run noisecov         --recording rest_b --from S --to E --name rest_b_h_cov
      nxr-neuro run region_pca       --recording rest_b --from S --to E --kernel lcmv_b --covariance rest_b_h_cov --partition desikan_killiany --name fp_h_b   (step 15)
      nxr-neuro run fingerprint_band --recording rest_b --from S --to E --map fp_h_b --lower L --upper U                                                  (steps 17, 19)
  for each half h:
    nxr-neuro run fingerprint_features --recording rest --stem fp_h                                                                                         (steps 18, 19)
  then, across the cohort (`run fingerprint`, steps 20-25): --target fp_B_spectral --database fp_A_spectral (and fp_B_connectome / fp_A_connectome with --vector upper-triangle).

It cannot resolve: what each band's run cannot (fingerprint_band); a bin belongs to the band whose source model made it (the release does not hold this export: the cut is the only reading
that reproduces its notebooks' table sizes, recorded as an inference in the provenance).

  nxr-neuro run fingerprint_features --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --stem fp_A
```
